scientific_question: Can a no-GT lexicographic prompt-stability and proposal-source agreement graph recover the useful LayerCAM plus BiomedCLIP proposal-gallery oracle without the scalar-score failure observed in prior selectors?

prior_evidence_lock.interpretation: The proposal pool contains useful masks in every fixed subgroup, while the unchanged coverage_mass_sam selector does not recover them and significantly harms large lesions. Prior weighted source_consensus, causal, prompt_hybrid and related scalar selectors are not repeated.

baseline_lock.method: promoted binary LayerCAM plus horizontal-flip TTA

operation: Within each morphology component, choose one SAM candidate lexicographically by availability and minimum/median IoU agreement with candidates generated by the other prompt modes, then SAM predicted IoU only as a late tie-breaker.
Create an IoU agreement graph over component medoids with a fixed 0.50 edge threshold and use deterministic connected components as proposal clusters.
Rank clusters lexicographically by independent proposal-source count, component support count, median cluster cohesion, prompt stability and SAM predicted IoU.
Keep at most three distinct clusters. Cross-source clusters rank first, but single-source clusters remain eligible as a fallback for small lesions missed by one proposal source.

execution_order: Verify exact source, split, checkpoints and all 371 physical saliency-map hashes without segmentation GT.
Run focused selector, proposal-gallery and prediction-first tests.
Generate all 371 pseudo masks and 184 complete schema-v2 candidate diagnostics without segmentation GT.
Audit source labels, prompt labels, candidate counts and freeze both prediction manifests.
Only after the freeze, load validation GT in separate evaluators.
Compare paired per-image final and oracle Dice against the frozen promoted baseline using complete-group bootstrap 10000 overall and in fixed small, medium and large subgroups.

promotion_gates.direct_train_pseudo_mask_generation: Overall final-Dice paired CI95 lower bound > 0 and final mean Dice does not decrease in any fixed size subgroup.
promotion_gates.next_selector_research: If the direct gate fails, retain only mechanism evidence and do not generate train pseudo masks.
